thesis: No entry. The account is flat, so there is nothing to manage and the only question is whether to open. This check builds on the 21:00 research note rather than repeating it. That note made XRPUSDT the contract to re-check first and, unusually, stated in advance exactly what would change the answer: a break AND hold above 1.4969 on expanding volume would supply the price-action trigger that a mid-range price could not, or a retest of 1.4847/1.4894 that held would give a better entry and a wider margin over the reward/risk floor. Neither happened, and the third possibility the note did not enumerate is what occurred: the breakout failed. XRPUSDT never traded above 1.4969, which still stands as today's high from the 11:00Z hour, and instead broke down through the 1.4847 floor of the four-hour range, printing 1.4765 in the 14:05Z 5m bar and trading at 1.4819/1.4824 now. That puts it back below the 1.4894 swing high of 2026-09-14 that the 21:00 note recorded it as having cleared. The level it broke above one hour ago is overhead again. This matters more than the arithmetic, which has if anything improved: on the same structural stop at 1.4700 below the 1.4710 and 1.4717 post-breakout lows, and the same 1.5270 target from the 2026-08-24 daily high, a 1.4824 entry gives 0.0124 of risk against 0.0446 of reward, a net reward/risk of 3.43 after a 0.002075 round-trip cost estimate, against 1.58 an hour ago. That number must not be read as the setup getting better. It doubled for one reason, that price fell 0.51% toward a fixed stop and compressed the risk leg; the improvement is the market moving against the thesis, not evidence accumulating for it. Treating it as a green light would be the exact error the strategy warns about when it forbids choosing a stop to fit a desired size, in the mirror image. The evidence test, which is what rejected XRP at 21:00, now fails harder rather than more narrowly. Price action has flipped from neutral to actively against: a failed breakout is named in the strategy as a price-action pattern, and here it points down, not up. Volume has flipped the same way. The 21:00 note's complaint was that participation contracted through the whole advance; this hour participation finally expanded, and it expanded on the wrong side. The 13:00Z hour traded 4,089,988,720 against 3,445,568,944 the hour before, but the single largest 5m bar in the last seventy minutes, 519,907,895 at 14:05Z, is the down bar that broke the range and printed 1.4765. Expanding volume on the break of the range low is confirmation of the failure, not of the move. That leaves trend and market_context, which the strategy and the 21:00 note both establish are one observation and not two on a day when the whole complex moved on a single 08:00Z impulse, and market_context has itself weakened: four of the five contracts gave back ground in the hour, with XRP the worst at +7.18% from +8.16%, ETH +5.67% from +6.08%, BTC +5.67% from +5.87% and BNB +5.04% from +5.15%, SOL alone extending to +8.82% from +8.25%. Derivatives remains permissive rather than supportive with funding at the 0.0100% baseline and the open-interest series unavailable on this host. One supporting category at most, against a requirement of two independent ones. Rejected. A separate and sufficient reason to decline XRP even if the categories had been there: the 1.4700 stop is now only 0.84% below the entry, and the 14:05Z 5m bar alone spanned 1.4765 to 1.4891, a 0.85% range. The stop is inside one five-minute bar of the current tape, it rests on the exchange triggered by the mark price, and the strategy is explicit that an artifact can trigger a resting order in an environment that has now printed four of them today. ETHUSDT is the one candidate that genuinely improved, and it is the reason this check was worth running. The 21:00 note said ETH only works on a pullback toward 2694-2700 and had moved away from it; the pullback has now happened, from a 2739.52 ask back to 2723.87. On the unchanged structural stop at 2693.00 and the unchanged 2771.00 target from the 2026-08-21 daily high, that is 30.87 of risk against 47.13 of reward, a net reward/risk of 1.40 after a 3.8134 cost estimate, recovering from 0.55 an hour ago and 1.34 at 20:00. It is still below the 1.50 floor and is rejected on that. The floor is a rule and 1.40 is not 1.50; it is not rounded up, and the stop is not moved to 2700 to manufacture the difference, which would put it inside the very level whose break defines the setup. The margin is also far too fine to treat as a near miss worth stretching for: the entry that would produce exactly 1.50 is 2722.68, 1.19 below the current ask, which is less than one 5m bar of ETH noise and less than the 9.29 bps spread implies in slippage terms. The honest reading is that ETH has returned to almost exactly where it was at 20:00 and fails for the third consecutive check on the same arithmetic, having failed at 1.34, 0.55 and now 1.40. BTCUSDT has produced a fourth confirmed artifact and is excluded again: the 13:50Z 5m bar printed a 86769.40 high against a 85448.00 close on 4,072 of volume, carrying the 13:00Z hourly high to 86769.40 against an 85353.30 open and 85405.00 close, a 1.66% upper wick against a 0.06% body, with nothing comparable in ETH, BNB, SOL or XRP in that window. BTC's spread has also widened from 0.43 bps at 21:00 to 15.37 bps now, 61% of the 25 bps limit, which is a second and independent sign that this contract's book is not behaving. SOLUSDT and BNBUSDT are rejected unchanged on a re-verified 60-day daily scan: for both, and for BTC, the only daily high anywhere above the current price in 60 days is today's own high, so there is no structural target and no reward/risk to compute, however clean SOL's tape looks. SOL printed a new high at 118.52 in the 14:05Z bar and gave it back inside the same bar. A short was reconsidered with more care than at 21:00 because XRP's failed breakout is the first bearish price-action item the experiment has seen, and it was still rejected. The best-constructed version, short 1.4819 with a stop at 1.4920 above the 14:00Z hourly high and a target at 1.4717 on the post-breakout low, gives 0.0101 of risk against 0.0102 of reward and a net 0.80, which fails the floor outright. Reaching for 1.4383 as a target to fix the ratio would require the entire day's impulse to reverse inside the 24-hour limit and would be a target invented to satisfy the arithmetic, which is prohibited. More fundamentally the bar for a short is the same two independent categories as for a long, only price_action supports the down direction, trend and market_context both argue against it, and the strategy states plainly that shorting is not a reaction to a red candle. One failed breakout on one contract in a complex still up 5-9% on the day is exactly that. LESSONS.md holds no lessons yet because the experiment has no closed trades, so no lesson applied. The guidance actually carried forward is the 21:00 research note's own next-task focus, and it was followed to the letter: XRP was re-checked first and tested against the two specific price conditions that note named, both of which failed; ETH was re-tested only after the pullback it required had actually occurred, with the stop re-derived from structure rather than carried up with the price; and BTC was declined on artifacts, which produced a fourth. That note's closing judgement, that a passing reward/risk number is not sufficient on its own and that the floor rejecting trades into extension is the floor working, was applied twice here, once to refuse a 3.43 that exists only because price fell toward the stop, and once to refuse to round a 1.40 up to the floor.

evidence.observed: XRPUSDT's breakout has failed. The 21:00 note named two triggers: a break and hold above 1.4969 on expanding volume, or a retest of 1.4847/1.4894 that holds. Neither occurred. 1.4969 was never touched again and still stands as today's high from the 11:00Z hour. Instead the 14:05Z 5m bar broke the 1.4847 floor of the four-hour range and printed 1.4765, and price now trades 1.4819/1.4824, back below the 1.4894 swing high of 2026-09-14 that the 21:00 note recorded as cleared. A failed breakout is a price-action pattern named in the strategy, and here it points down. Direction: argues against the XRP long. ETHUSDT by contrast completed the pullback the 21:00 note required, from a 2739.52 ask to 2723.87, with the 14:05Z low at 2718.49 marginally under the 2719.08 low of the 12:00Z hour. SOLUSDT printed a new 24h and 60-day high of 118.52 at 14:05Z and gave it back inside the same bar to 117.86.

XRPUSDT participation finally expanded and expanded on the wrong side. The 13:00Z hour traded 4,089,988,720 against 3,445,568,944 in the 12:00Z hour, ending the hour-by-hour contraction the 21:00 note documented, but the single largest 5m bar of the last seventy minutes is 519,907,895 at 14:05Z, which is the down bar that broke the range low and printed 1.4765. The second largest, 500,049,575 at 13:55Z, closed flat at 1.4900. Expansion on the break of the range low confirms the failure rather than the advance. Direction: argues against the XRP long, and the 21:00 note's stated condition of a break on EXPANDING volume is not satisfied because there was no break higher to expand into. ETHUSDT hourly volume contracted, 2,106,222 in the 13:00Z hour against 2,218,225 in the 12:00Z hour, so volume does not support the ETH long either.

The daily uptrend is intact on all five and is the only category supporting a long. XRPUSDT daily lows continue to rise, 1.3953 on 09-19, 1.3697 on 09-20, 1.4042 today, and today's candle is a large green body from 1.4098. A 60-day daily scan confirms BTCUSDT, BNBUSDT and SOLUSDT have no daily high above the current price other than today's own, while ETHUSDT has 2771.00 from 2026-08-21 and XRPUSDT has 1.4894 (09-14), 1.4969 (today), 1.5270 (08-24), 1.5441 (08-25), 1.5444 (08-23) and 1.7000 (08-22). Direction: supports long, rules out short. Independence caveat, unchanged from 21:00 and decisive again: this is the same single 08:00Z complex-wide impulse that market_context describes, not a second observation.

The complex turned lower in the hour, having extended in each of the three previous checks. Four of five gave back ground against the 21:00 readings: XRP +7.18% (was +8.16%), ETH +5.67% (was +6.08%), BTC +5.67% (was +5.87%), BNB +5.04% (was +5.15%). SOL alone extended, +8.82% (was +8.25%). XRP went from the second strongest to the weakest of the five in one hour, which is the relative-strength reading the strategy asks for and it is negative for the contract being considered. Direction: still supports long on an absolute basis but has weakened, and it remains the same observation as trend rather than an independent second category.

Funding checked as the entry conditions require. All five at or below the 0.0100% baseline after a 5-9% day: BTCUSDT 0.002122% (turned positive from -0.0038% at 21:00), ETHUSDT 0.010000%, BNBUSDT 0.000000%, SOLUSDT 0.010000%, XRPUSDT 0.010000%. Next funding 2026-09-21T16:00Z for all five, about 1.8 hours out; a long on XRP, ETH or SOL would pay 0.01%. The demo host still does not serve /futures/data/openInterestHist, so open-interest change is unmeasurable here and this category reduces to funding alone, which says only that longs are not crowded. Direction: permissive, not supportive. It cannot be counted toward the two-category requirement and it argues against a short.

lessons_applied: None available: 05-交易记录-data/reviews/LESSONS.md records no lessons yet because the experiment has no closed trades. The 22:00 daily review owns that folder and may be running concurrently; nothing under reviews/ was read for writing or modified. The guidance actually carried forward is the 21:00 research note's next-task focus, followed item by item. Item 1, re-check XRPUSDT first against 1.4969 (a break and hold on expanding volume) and 1.4847/1.4894 (a retest that holds): both were tested and both failed, with price breaking the 1.4847 floor instead, and the note's explicit warning that a break on contracting volume is not a trigger was extended to its own logic, that expansion appearing on the down bar is confirmation of failure rather than of the move. Item 2, do not re-test ETHUSDT at a higher price without re-deriving the stop from structure: ETH was re-tested only because it pulled back rather than advanced, and the 2693.00 stop was re-verified against the 2694.94 post-breakout low rather than carried along with price. Item 3, BTC remains excluded while artifacts print: a fourth was found and recorded. The 21:00 note's closing judgement, that a passing reward/risk number is not sufficient on its own and that the floor rejecting trades into extension is the floor working rather than a problem to engineer around, was applied in both directions here, refusing a 3.43 on XRP that exists only because price fell toward a fixed stop, and refusing to round ETH's 1.40 up to the floor or to move its stop to reach it.
